name: helioterm
description: Independent model-bound semantic terminal with deterministic commands and persisted proof.

interface.longDescription: HelioTerm batches bounded Node and Python tests, build, read-only Git, search, file-list, benchmark, and process observations into one deterministic local call with compact output; a reusable Luna leaf is the explicit model-backed fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use $helioterm direct mode and batch all bounded observations into one local call.
